intro: Science test is coming! Let's review water, food and the amazing camel!
curtir: Before we keep going... subscribe to the channel and leave a like!
ultima: Last question! This one is worth the grade!
outro: So, are you ready for the science test? Subscribe to the channel!
placar10: Ten questions done! Do you remember everything?
placar20: Twenty done! How many did you get right?
placar30: Thirty! Get ready, the very hard level is coming!
q1: Forty-nine review questions, from medium to very hard, and the last one is worth the grade! Which one is one of the three home activities that use the most water? Drinking a glass of water, Flushing the toilet or Brushing your teeth?
q2: Taking a shower. Is it Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p2: Direct Use! We can see the water being used.
q3: Tommy loves to eat. For breakfast, he eats a banana and what? Chocolate cake, Whole-grain bread or Candy?
p3: Whole-grain bread! A banana and whole-grain bread, a healthy breakfast.
q5: Eating a hamburger. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p5: Virtual Use! The water was used to make the hamburger.
q6: And what does Tommy drink during the day to help his body? Soda, Nothing or Water?
p6: Water! He drinks water during the day.
q7: True or false? A camel keeps water inside its hump.
p7: False! The hump stores fat, not water.
p8: Unhealthy! It has a lot of sugar.
q9: Tommy loves candy and soda too. But what should he NOT eat every day? Rice and beans, Candy and soda or Banana and bread?
p9: Candy and soda! Only once in a while.
q10: Washing clothes. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
q11: What unit do we use to measure the water used to produce food? Kilograms, Liters or Meters?
q12: Complete the sentence: fruits and vegetables are examples of what foods? Healthy, Virtual or Desert?
q14: What do the camel's wide, padded feet do? Stop it sinking in sand, Let it eat thorny plants or Store fat?
p14: They stop the camel from sinking into the sand!
q15: Which one of these uses more water? Washing the car with a hose, Using a watering can or Drinking a glass of water?
p15: Washing the car with a hose! The water keeps running.
p16: Unhealthy! A lot of salt and fat.
q17: Brushing your teeth. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
q18: Rice and beans. Healthy or unhealthy?
q19: Which one is also one of the three home activities that use the most water? Washing clothes, Watering the plants or Brushing your teeth?
p19: Washing clothes! The three are: flushing the toilet, taking a shower or a bath, and washing clothes.
q20: Drinking a glass of milk. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p20: Virtual Use! The water that counts was used to produce the milk.
q21: A farmer uses water to grow tomatoes. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p21: Virtual Use! The water is used to produce food.
q22: What do the camel's nostrils that close do? Keep sand out of the eyes, Keep sand out of the nose or Store fat?
p22: They keep the sand out of the nose!
q23: Using a sheet of paper. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p23: Virtual Use! Water was used to make the paper.
q24: A factory uses water to make a T-shirt. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p24: Virtual Use! It counts for products too, not only food.
q25: What do the camel's thick lips do? Eat thorny plants, Stop it sinking in sand or Keep water?
p25: They let the camel eat thorny desert plants without pain!
q26: Watering the plants. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
q27: How many liters of water to produce one banana? About 160 liters, About 16 liters or About 1,600 liters?
q28: Which food needs the most water to be produced? Egg, Glass of milk or Hamburger?
p28: The hamburger! About two thousand four hundred liters.
q29: Buying a pair of shoes. Direct Use or Virtual Use?
p29: Virtual Use! It is a ready product.
q30: What does the camel's thick fur do? Protects from sun and cold, Stores fat or Keeps sand out of the eyes?
p30: It protects the camel from the hot sun and also from the cold desert nights!
q31: Which food needs the least water? Tomato, Potato or Apple?
q32: What is an adaptation? A kind of food, A feature to survive or Water we cannot see?
p32: A special feature that helps an animal survive where it lives!
q33: According to the text, healthy food helps Tommy do what? Eat more candy, Sleep in class or Grow and stay strong?
p33: Grow, stay strong and have energy to play soccer with his friends!
q34: How many liters of water to produce one slice of bread? About 4 liters, About 400 liters or About 40 liters?
p35: Unhealthy! A lot of sugar and fat.
q36: Which usually needs more water: food from animals or food from plants?
p36: Food from animals! It needs much more water.
q37: How many liters of water to produce one egg? About 135 liters, About 13 liters or About 70 liters?
q38: What do the camel's long eyelashes and thick eyebrows do? Keep sand out of the nose, Keep sand out of the eyes or Give energy?
p38: They keep the sand out of the eyes and shade them from the sun!
q39: How many liters of water to produce one glass of milk? About 200 liters, About 20 liters or About 2,000 liters?
q40: Which is the right order, from the least water to the most? Apple, tomato, egg, Egg, apple, tomato or Tomato, apple, egg?
p40: Tomato, apple, egg! Thirteen, seventy and one hundred thirty-five liters.
q41: How many liters of water to produce one hamburger? About 2,400 liters, About 240 liters or About 24 liters?
p41: About two thousand four hundred liters!
q42: How many liters of water to produce one kilogram of beef?
p42: Fifteen thousand liters per kilogram! Much more than everything else.
q43: Unhealthy food has a lot of what? Water and milk, Sugar, salt or fat or Fruit and vegetables?
q44: An egg needs about one hundred thirty-five liters. An apple, seventy. How many more liters does the egg need?
p44: Sixty-five liters! One hundred thirty-five minus seventy.
q46: Complete the sentence: we need what to survive? Soda, Candy or Water?
p46: Water! We need water to survive.
q47: What do the camel's long legs do? Keep the body off hot sand, Run from lions or Store fat?
p47: They keep the body away from the hot sand!
q48: True or false? A camel can drink a lot of water at once and go many days without drinking.
p48: True! Another adaptation for the desert.
q49: This one is worth the grade! The hump stores fat. Why is the fat useful in the desert? Gives energy with no food, Cools the body or Stores water?
p49: It gives energy when there is no food! The hump stores fat, not water. If you got this one, you are ready for the test!
s49: For the grade... the answer is...
